question: How is the network performing right now? Which routes or areas need attention?
What is abnormal right now that I probably haven’t noticed yet?
Are today’s delays scattered across the network, or concentrated around a particular corridor or terminal?
Why is Route 66 performing badly this morning? Is it traffic, long dwell times, missing trips, or uneven departures?
Why is bus 1827 twenty minutes behind schedule? Where did the delay begin?
This trip is late now. Which downstream trips, reliefs, connections, or blocks will it affect over the next two hours?
Where are buses bunching, and is this a single bad pair or a corridor-wide headway problem?
Where will riders experience unusually long gaps during the next 30 minutes?
Why is there a 35-minute gap here? Was a trip cancelled, never dispatched, short-turned, or simply not reporting?
Has the Red Line been unusually unreliable this week, or does today merely feel terrible because humans remember pain better than normality?
Something appears wrong around Harvard Square. What changed, when did it start, and which services are involved?
Routes 39, 55, and 57 all became late around the same place. Is there evidence of a common disruption?
A crash is blocking this intersection. Which routes, trips, stops, and riders are likely to be affected?
If nothing is done, what will service look like 30, 60, and 90 minutes from now?
If the blockage clears at 4:20, when should headways return approximately to normal?
Should we hold, short-turn, express, insert another vehicle, or leave the service alone?
If I short-turn this bus at Kenmore, what happens to waits on both sides of the turn?
I have two spare buses and three routes deteriorating. Where would an extra vehicle produce the largest benefit?
Which bus-to-rail or bus-to-bus connections are at high risk of being missed, and should any departures be held?
Where is demand exceeding available capacity, and is it caused by unusually high demand or degraded service?
Do we have enough usable vehicles to operate the PM peak? Which pull-outs are at risk?
Which operator reliefs or assignments are endangered by the current delays?
This vehicle has generated repeated door and propulsion warnings. Can it finish the block, or should we swap it?
Are repeated delays at this station associated with elevators, signals, fare gates, platforms, construction, or something outside the system?
Operationally this is a 14-minute headway deviation. What does that actually mean for passengers at the affected stops?
If this segment is suspended, what practical alternatives can we give riders from A to B right now?
What should we tell riders about this disruption, separately for the app, station signs, and social media?
Does the current alert actually cover everyone affected, or are we missing stations, directions, accessibility impacts, or useful alternatives?
Can I trust this conclusion? Are we seeing a real service problem or bad/missing AVL, GTFS-RT, APC, or dispatch data?
What happened yesterday between 4 and 6 PM, what caused the worst passenger impacts, what actions were taken, and did those actions improve service?
What is going on with the 39?
Anything I should worry about for the evening peak?
